summary: RESOLVED - no longer blocking. The blocker was sibling task 371's live uncommitted edits to core/scripts/roadmap-integration.sh and core/scripts/tests/test-roadmap-generation.sh, which would have been swept into the deployed tree by Phase 4's unconditional deploy-headless.sh. All three clearing conditions now hold: 371 is status=completed (terminal), both named files are committed and clean (git status --porcelain empty), and the cycle-4 Inter-Cycle Redeploy Checkpoint already ran deploy-headless.sh (RESULT=landed_verify_skipped) so all four of this task's scoped files are at byte parity with their deployed counterparts (4/4 cmp -s pass). Phases 1-3 are committed; the working tree is clean across this task's file_scope and its index-entries.json excursion (landed in f555069ef). The deploy half of Phase 4 is therefore already satisfied; only verification, attribution and closure remain. One NEW obstacle supersedes the original blocker: Phase 4's literal verification criterion 'verify-deploy.sh exits 0 - the complete gate set, not a selected subset and not --skip-slow' is UNMEETABLE for reasons wholly outside this task's scope (see root_cause).
root_cause: Two distinct causes, one historical and one live. (1) ORIGINAL BLOCKER - a gate blindness, not an authoring fault: the batch admission gate detects co-dispatch hazards by intersecting declared file_scope sets, but deploy-headless.sh regenerates the ENTIRE deployed .claude/ tree from current filesystem state. Tasks 371 and 372 had strictly disjoint file_scope (which is precisely why they were co-dispatched into the same wave), yet both plans terminate in a whole-tree redeploy phase. Disjoint file_scope does not imply deploy-safe concurrency, and no declared-scope intersection can ever express a whole-tree operation, so the gate cannot see this class of collision. The implementing agent caught it only by reading git status at Phase 4 entry and correctly refused rather than publishing a sibling's unverified work. (2) LIVE OBSTACLE - verify-deploy.sh cannot exit 0 in this repository for a pre-existing, unrelated reason documented by task 371 as iss_1791597799615_hKfFjt: test-verify-deploy-context-budget.sh's fixture runs 'git init' on a scratch dir but never 'git add', so Gate 22 (shellcheck lint) discovers its file set via 'git ls-files' against an empty index, finds zero .sh files, and exits 2, which Gate 22 correctly treats as FAIL - failing Gate 8 (run-all.sh) and thus the full gate set, 1 of 36 checks. Cycle 4's own baseline comparison independently corroborates this as pre-existing and not introduced here: pre=1 post=1 new=0 proceeded=true. deploy-headless.sh's normal fast-gate path (--skip-slow) is unaffected and reports 35/35 clean.
solution_path: Re-dispatch this task's implement phase; the original blocker needs no action. Phase 4 reduces to verification and closure, roughly 10 minutes: (1) SKIP the redeploy or re-run deploy-headless.sh idempotently - the checkpoint already deployed and parity is confirmed 4/4; (2) re-confirm source/deployed parity for the four scoped files with the plan's own diff -q loop; (3) run 'bash .claude/scripts/verify-deploy.sh' and expect exactly ONE failure, Gate 8 via test-verify-deploy-context-budget.sh; (4) attribute that failure as pre-existing rather than fixing it - it is outside this task's four-file scope and Phase 4's own task list already instructs 'if a gate fails in a file outside this plan's four-file scope ... report rather than fixing a sibling's file'. Cite iss_1791597799615_hKfFjt and the pre=1/post=1/new=0 baseline as the evidence; (5) close Phase 4 as [COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS] with a '#### Reasoned Exclusions' record naming the unmeetable criterion and its evidence - exactly the precedent task 371's Phase 6 set for this same fixture defect, rather than reporting a false green or leaving the task indefinitely partial; (6) write the implementation summary and mark the task implemented. TWO HOUSEKEEPING FIXES for the next handoff, flagged by this dispatch's own validator as 2 warnings: populate continuation_path/continuation_context (both null while status=partial, which is self-inconsistent) and add the required phase/target fields to the blockers[] entry. ONE SYSTEMIC RECOMMENDATION outside this task's scope, worth its own task: teach the admission gate that a plan phase invoking deploy-headless.sh (or any whole-tree regeneration) constitutes an implicit scope claim over the entire deployed tree, so two such tasks serialize even when their declared file_scope sets are disjoint.
